Quibell's stamped-gold djed material belongs to the Tell er Roba / Tell el-Rub'a 1902 tomb branch; its exact JE/CG passport remains open.

spine/backbone plus phallus in the Dendera procession does not prove physical pairing of a djed object with CG 53469.
djed-as-spine symbolism is not equivalent to proof that a specific gold djed was the procession's spine relic.
